Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Cramped
Hirelings: 1
Order: Craft

A number of ravens equal to your level roost here. Whenever a creature enters, the birds track its movement with an unfathomable intelligence behind their beady eyes.

Craft: Mist Talisman. The hireling sends ravens to contacts in a Domain of Dread you have visited or heard of from a creature that has been there. After 21 days, during which the facility does nothing else, the hireling produces a Mist talisman linked to that domain.

Messenger Ravens. Whenever you finish a Long Rest in your Bastion, you can send a raven carrying a written message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met, or one described to you by someone who has met it. The recipient can attach a reply; either way, the raven returns after 7 days. It can travel any distance, provided the recipient is on the plane of your Bastion or in a demiplane linked to it by the Mists of Ravenloft, and it delivers its message despite magical wards, the Mists, or the closed borders of a domain. If it can't deliver the message, it returns with it after 7 days.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
